parsed.explanation: Score elevated risk. Direct cross-dressing offence repealed in 2018; majority public acceptance, toleration, pride and decriminalisation backing lower exposure. No visitor-facing border, facility, custody or care restrictions are documented; unknowns are not safety and keep the rating below reduced-risk. Absent resident machinery is not counted against travellers. Weak recourse remains the main visitor exposure if outed.
